replies.subject: Rates - Narmada Cartons
replies.body:
Pavan sir,

Photo of our rate card attached, rates per kg as usual. ISO certificate also attached.

Your questions: ISO 9001 certified (copy attached). No FSC. BCT reports yes, ECT testing in-house. Capacity 3 lakh boxes per month. Lead time 7 days. 2 complaints last year. We can run a stock point inside Plant 2. Supply to both plants yes. Printing no. Mill certificates yes. Recycled declaration no.

replies.subject: RE: RFQ-2026-014
replies.body:
Hi Pavan,

₹42/kg for the 5-ply, 38 for the 3-ply, rest same as last year, freight extra. Per-kg rates are for the RSC boxes; everything else as per our contract 2025-V5.

ISO 9001 and FSC certified (certificates on file with you, ISO valid till Feb 2027). BCT reports with every lot and we test ECT in-house. Capacity 3.5 lakh boxes a month, lead time 12 days, zero quality complaints this year. Buffer stock and both plants as today. We print up to two colours. Recycled content declared; mill certificates not usually shared. Payment 60 days is fine.

Thanks,
Suresh Patil
Sahyadri Paperpack
